VERIFY cocond-markov-poincare-ot r0_2 -- check (b) trainability and coupled switch. Static trace of train_rqvae.py:316-330 -> RQVAE.forward -> RQLayer.forward -> VQLayer.forward: the baseline Euclidean path is differentiable (quant_loss at layers.py:132, straight-through at layers.py:133, codebook embed.weight is nn.Embedding parameter at layers.py:62), and loss finiteness is guarded at train_rqvae.py:322-323. But the proposal's coupled pathway does not exist: no three switches (behaviour on/off, curvature on/off) exist in the code, no transition matrix is built or passed, and no Poincare distance/barycenter is applied, so switching behaviour off or replacing curvature with Euclidean is impossible and no SID/gradient change can occur. The only Sinkhorn is the original Euclidean one (layers.py:81-113) gated to self.training and last level only (layers.py:260-261), and export uses infer_use_sk=False (train_rqvae.py:415-417) so exported SIDs are plain argmin. Dead hyperbolic helpers in model/utils.py:162-329 are never in the autograd graph, so no gradient reaches any curved operation. Verdict: NEEDS_FIX (blocking). Open: check (c) integration.
